findings.summary: The 1x1 shortcut in get_delta_weight only checks the first two spatial dims and uses 2D-only squeezes, so Conv3d with a (1,1,1) kernel yields a wrong-shaped tensor or error during merge, and a (3,1,1) kernel wrongly takes the 1x1 path.
The Conv3d error message wrongly says "Conv2d layer kernel must have 5 dimensions" instead of Conv3d.

conv_fn is set after super().__init__() (which calls update_layer), so init paths like PiSSA, OLoRA or LoftQ that call get_delta_weight or merge code early may raise AttributeError; the kernel-dimension validation also runs only after the layers are built.
